chunks: 2336 - Hudhayfah ibn Mansur said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
My uncle swept the Kaaba and took some of its soil, and we use it for treatment.
So he said: “Return it to it.”

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: the Kaaba, the sacred sanctuary in Mecca
key_terms.تُرَابِهَا: its soil, referring to the dust or earth of the Kaaba
key_terms.حُذَيْفَةُ: Hudhayfah, the narrator speaking to the Imam
key_terms.رُدَّهُ: return it, the Imam's instruction regarding the taken soil
key_terms.نَتَدَاوَى: we seek treatment, meaning we use it medicinally

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to take soil from the Kaaba for personal use or treatment?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that some soil was taken from the Kaaba and used medicinally. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام instructed that it be returned, indicating that such material was not to be appropriated for personal use.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2336 - Hudhayfah ibn Mansur said to Abu Abdullah (as):
"My uncle swept the Kaaba and took some of its soil, and we use it for treatment."
Imam (as) replied: "Return it to the Kaaba."
